Technical changelog

Source: CHANGELOG.md

Unreleased

  • Add production archive version checks for configured and one-off destinations. Record the destination’s completed project version after its last upload. The Git upstream restriction now uses not_behind_git and accepts the historical not_behind key.

  • Resolve args_engine against the selected build engines before rendering. Each engine uses its own options for rendering and output collection.

0.7.0

  • Add projr_reproduce() to select a build by branch, version or commit, restore its inputs and compare a fresh production render against its recorded output and documentation snapshots.
  • Resolve registered GitHub and local destinations from remotes. A build selects a registered destination by name and can restrict its content. A GitHub destination can specify its own repository and release tag.
  • Add projr_get(), projr_get_local() and projr_get_github() for versioned reads into label-specific folders. Stage the files and verify the directory snapshot before replacing any local contents.

0.6.1

  • Reserve version initialization, version transitions and rollback for production builds. Use a development cache when no version exists.
  • Accept exclude: pattern items alongside paths in YAML script lists. Apply exclusions across the selection. An exclusion-only list filters the renderer’s automatic project inputs and the automatically discovered R scripts.
  • Preserve manual ignore patterns and their line endings during managed updates. Seed editable ignore rules when initializing a project.
  • Make data a reserved path for package datasets. Check a conflicting directory label only when projr_use_data() is called. Collect staged datasets into data/ and R/sysdata.rda before building the package.
  • Default configured package data to inclusion in Git and source packages. Migrate the ignore files to one outer block. Keep the published README’s linked figures and hand-written HTML trackable.
  • Include the README renderer and, for a README that loads its own package, pkgbuild in the production prerequisite check.
  • Use the checkout’s populated analysis library for render subprocesses when a late package DESCRIPTION redirects renv to an empty project library. Restore the caller’s library settings on exit.
  • Migrate the root build log into .projr/ using the same conflict checks as other project bookkeeping. Older checkouts support read-only lookups.
  • Return the earliest version in the final run of matching file hashes from projr_manifest_file_last_change(), including when a file has the same hash in every build.

0.6.0

  • Development and production build functions accept project. Interactive approval is stored per canonical checkout path in the user’s projr configuration directory. An explicit root in an unattended build grants approval for that invocation. The check precedes the first project write.
  • The build records input and output directory snapshots in separate phases. Each label’s versions.csv maps project versions to shared files-<snapshot>.csv lists. Empty directory versions are representable. Local archives store these histories in manifests/. GitHub releases store them together in manifest.zip.
  • Script selection is applied to the merged active profile. Each glob expands alphabetically, and exclusions apply across the selection. Repeating an explicit R script or standalone document repeats its execution. The build temporarily updates the Quarto or Bookdown project YAML and restores it on completion or failure.
  • Managed Git and R package ignore rules combine eligible directory paths across profiles. They are regenerated from current project configuration. Rendered documents and companion assets are collected together, including documents in nested directories.
  • GitHub restore checks all selected directories against the requested build before installing downloaded files. Release templates resolve once per build.
  • Directory indexes and file lists keep their original bytes when checked out with Git line-ending conversion enabled. Project-relative paths also work when the operating system uses an alias for a checkout directory.
